Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.38 is a compatibility hotfix. With CutePortraits or a portrait manager enabled, the selected portrait no longer reverts to the default/native portrait when a customer finishes walking in and stops at the counter; Auto mode leaves another portrait source alone and no longer rewrites portrait keys for characters this mod does not own. In two-person visits, the rear character's first line no longer shows the native security-officer name; the companion name is written again after the native SEC name plate initializes. Genuine security two-person scenes keep their officer name. Story, routes, choices, target days, schedules and endings are unchanged; the 1.37 and earlier fixes remain. 1.38 为兼容性热修：与少女当铺/立绘管理器一起启用时，角色入场后完全停下时不再把已选立绘改回默认/原生立绘；Auto 模式不再覆盖其他立绘来源，也不再改写不属于本 MOD 角色的立绘键。双角色到访时，后场角色第一句不再显示原生“治安部警官”，会在原生 SEC 名字牌初始化后再次写入同伴名；真正的保安双人场景仍显示警官名。不改剧情、路线、选项结果、目标日、结局或排期；保留 1.37 及更早修复。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
